question: How does the Devīyāmala describe the divine principle manifesting as teacher?
premises: The Devīyāmala is cited as the authority.
The teaching is located in the section named fifty-two.
The god, wishing to stand as teacher, becomes tenfold.
inference: According to the Devīyāmala, the one divine teacher principle manifests in ten forms.
uncertainties: The exact reference of dvāpañcāśāhva āhnike is text-specific and not fully clear from the verse alone.
plain_english: In the Devīyāmala, in the section called the fifty-two, it is said that the god himself, wishing to stand as teacher, becomes tenfold.
